_about: SAMPLE price classes for building the registration and price screens before Odoo is connected. The class NAMES are the ones already on the customer list; the multipliers are made up. In the real system a price class is an Odoo pricelist and the carton price for a product comes from its pricelist items (product.pricelist / product.pricelist.item), read by the sync. Nothing here is a real price.
